theory.body: AWS Step Functions describes the methods and patterns used within AWS Developer Associate to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why AWS Step Functions matters
theory.body: Without AWS Step Functions, systems built with AWS Developer Associate are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AWS Step Functions works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AWS Step Functions follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AWS Step Functions
theory.body: AWS Step Functions offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
